title: Protect Views with Login Required
description: Add login‑required protection to several views and test the redirect.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Take your existing views (e.g., a `profile` view that shows the user's profile, and a `dashboard` view) and protect them so that only authenticated users can access them.

Use the `@login_required` decorator. Configure the login URL in `settings.py` (usually `LOGIN_URL = '/accounts/login/'`).

Test by trying to access the view while logged out – you should be redirected to the login page, and after login, back to the original view.
hints: Set `LOGIN_URL` in settings if you're not using the default '/accounts/login/'.
You may need to create a login template if you haven't yet (though built‑in views can provide one).
expectedOutput: When accessing a protected view while logged out, you are redirected to the login page. After logging in, you are redirected back to the original page.
